scope: v2 tape, WHOLE record (all markets), deduped by (tx_hash,evt_index), v2_a/v2_b, OrderFilled

self_dealing.definition: a wallet is a maker on one fill and the taker on another fill of the same tx_hash

method: deduped maker-fill + taker-order parts (block-ranged => a tx is wholly within one part); per-part tx-level both-sides group-by accumulated; fill-level self-match (mk=tk) separate.
